class.name: YAMLStyle
class.brief_description: Configures formatting behavior for YAML serialization.
class.description: [YAMLStyle] defines how Godot objects are serialized to YAML format. The class allows precise control over serialization styles, enabling better compatibility with existing YAML parsers and improving human readability of exported YAML content. The class supports hierarchical style organization through a parent-child relationship, allowing you to define specific styles per key. Child styles automatically inherit formatting from their parent unless explicitly overridden. For arrays, you can define a special [code]_template[/code] child style that will be applied to all array elements that don't have their own specific style defined.

method.name: apply_scalar_styles_to_children
method.description: Applies all scalar styles ([enum StringStyle], [enum IntegerFormat], and [enum FloatFormat]) to all child styles.

method.name: clear_child
method.description: Removes the child style associated with the specified [param key]. Returns this style instance for method chaining.

method.name: clear_children
method.description: Removes all child styles from this style instance. Returns this style instance for method chaining.

method.name: clone
method.description: Creates a deep copy of this style object. Returns a new [YAMLStyle] instance with identical settings and child styles, but no shared references with the original.

method.name: container_form_from_string
method.description: Converts a string identifier to the corresponding [enum ContainerForm] value.

method.name: container_form_string
method.description: Converts a [enum ContainerForm] value to its string identifier.

method.name: create_child
method.description: Creates a new child style for the specified [param key] if it doesn't exist, and returns the child. If [param propagate_scalar_styles] is [code]true[/code] (default), all scalar styles are copied from parent to child. See [method propagate_scalar_styles].

method.name: float_format_from_string
method.description: Converts a string identifier to the corresponding [enum FloatFormat] value.

method.name: float_format_string
method.description: Converts a [enum FloatFormat] value to its string identifier.

method.name: flow_style_from_string
method.description: Converts a string identifier to the corresponding [enum FlowStyle] value.

method.name: flow_style_string
method.description: Converts a [enum FlowStyle] value to its string identifier.

method.name: from_dictionary
get_at_path
method.description:
Gets a child style at the specified [param path]. The path uses [code]/[/code] as a separator, and array indices can be specified numerically. If [param create_if_missing] is [code]true[/code], any missing children in the path will be created. If [code]false[/code] and a child in the path doesn't exist, returns [code]null[/code]. [codeblock lang=gdscript] var style = YAML.create_style()
# Create nested style for items/0/properties var props_style = style.get_at_path("items/0/properties", true) props_style.set_flow_style(YAMLStyle.FLOW_SINGLE)
# This creates the full path: items -> 0 -> properties [/codeblock]

method.name: get_child
method.description: Returns the child style associated with the specified [param key], or [code]null[/code] if no child style exists for this key.

method.name: get_debug_string
method.description: Returns a detailed string representation of the style configuration, including all child styles. This method is useful for debugging and inspecting the style hierarchy.

method.name: has_child
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if a child style has been defined for the specified [param key], [code]false[/code] otherwise. Use this method to check for the existence of a child style before accessing it.

method.name: hash
method.description: Calculates a hash value for the style instance, including all its properties and child styles.

method.name: integer_format_from_string
method.description: Converts a string identifier to the corresponding [enum IntegerFormat] value.

method.name: integer_format_string
method.description: Converts an [enum IntegerFormat] value to its string identifier.

method.name: is_block_style
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if this style uses block string formatting (literal or folded), [code]false[/code] otherwise. Block styles are useful for multi-line string content.

method.name: list_children
method.description: Returns an [Array] containing all keys that have associated child styles. This helps iterate through all child styles defined in this style instance.

method.name: load_file
method.description: Loads a style from a YAML file at the specified [param path]. Returns a [YAMLResult] object containing either the new [YAMLStyle] instance or error information if the file couldn't be loaded or parsed.

method.name: merge_with
propagate_scalar_styles
method.description: Applies all scalar styles [enum StringStyle], [enum IntegerFormat], and [enum FloatFormat] to [param target] [YAMLStyle] instance.

method.name: save_file
method.description: Saves this style to a YAML file at the specified [param path]. Converts the style to a dictionary and writes it to disk. Returns a [YAMLResult] object that indicates success or contains error information if the operation failed.

method.name: set_child
method.description: Associates a child [param style] with the specified [param key]. Use this method to assign different formatting styles to specific elements within a YAML document. Returns this style instance for method chaining.

method.name: set_container_form
method.description: Sets the [member container_form] value to the specified [param style]. Returns this style instance for method chaining.

method.name: set_custom_settings
method.description: Sets the [member custom_settings] dictionary to the specified [param style]. Use this for implementation-specific styling options not covered by the standard properties. Returns this style instance for method chaining.

method.name: set_float_format
method.description: Sets the [member float_format] value to the specified [param format]. Returns this style instance for method chaining.

method.name: set_flow_style
method.description: Sets the [member flow_style] value to the specified [param style]. Returns this style instance for method chaining.

method.name: set_integer_format
method.description: Sets the [member integer_format] value to the specified [param format]. Returns this style instance for method chaining.

method.name: set_string_style
method.description: Sets the [member string_style] value to the specified [param style]. Returns this style instance for method chaining.

method.name: string_style_from_string
method.description: Converts a string identifier to the corresponding [enum StringStyle] value.

method.name: string_style_string
method.description: Converts a [enum StringStyle] value to its string identifier.

method.name: to_dictionary
method.description: Converts this style to a [Dictionary] representation. The dictionary contains all explicitly set properties and serialized child styles. This format is suitable for saving to a file or transferring between objects.

method.name: uses_flow
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if this style uses flow (inline) formatting for containers, [code]false[/code] otherwise. Flow styles typically result in more compact YAML representation.

method.name: uses_quotes
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if this style uses single or double quoted string formatting, [code]false[/code] otherwise. Quoted styles ensure strings are correctly interpreted in YAML.

members.member: Defines whether containers are serialized as arrays or dictionaries. See [enum ContainerForm] for available options.
A dictionary containing custom style settings not covered by standard properties. Used for implementation-specific styling options.
Controls how floating point numbers are formatted in the YAML output. See [enum FloatFormat] for available options.
Determines whether containers use flow style (inline) or block style formatting. See [enum FlowStyle] for available options.
Controls how integer numbers are formatted in the YAML output. See [enum IntegerFormat] for available options.
Determines how string values are formatted in the YAML output. See [enum StringStyle] for available options.

constants.constant: Lets the YAML stringifier automatically choose the container form based on content. This is the default behavior and typically selects the most appropriate format.

Forces the container to be serialized as an array (sequence in YAML terminology). Arrays are represented as ordered lists, typically with dash ([code]-[/code]) notation: [codeblock lang=text] my_array: - value1 - value2 - value3 [/codeblock] When combined with [constant FLOW_SINGLE] the value can be expressed in a single line: [codeblock lang="text"] my_array: [value1, value2, value3] [/codeblock]

Forces the container to be serialized as a dictionary (mapping in YAML terminology). Dictionaries are represented as key-value pairs using the colon ([code]:[/code]) notation: [codeblock lang="text"] my_dictionary: key1: some value key2: another value key3: more values [/codeblock] When combined with [constant FLOW_SINGLE] the value can be expressed in a single line: [codeblock lang="text"] my_dictionary: {key1: some value, key2: another value, key3: more values} [/codeblock]
Lets the YAML stringifier automatically choose the flow style based on content. This is the default behavior and typically selects the most human-readable format.
Forces block style (non-flow) formatting, where each element appears on its own line. This style prioritizes readability over compactness.

Forces flow style (inline) formatting, where elements appear on a single line separated by commas. This style produces more compact YAML but can be less readable for complex structures. See [constant FORM_ARRAY] and [constant FORM_DICTIONARY].
Lets the YAML stringifier automatically choose the string style based on content. This is the default behavior and typically selects the most appropriate format.
Use [code]plain unquoted string[/code] style. This style is most readable but cannot represent all characters and will be automatically quoted if necessary.
Forces [code]'single-quoted string'[/code] style. Single quotes preserve literal values except for escaped single quotes [code]''[/code].
Forces [code]"double-quoted string"[/code] style. Double quotes allow for escape sequences (like [code]\n[/code], [code]\t[/code]) for special characters.

Forces literal block string style (using the [code]|[/code] indicator). This preserves all newlines and is ideal for multi-line text where line breaks are significant. [codeblock lang=text] literal_string: | Literal block strings preserve all newlines. [/codeblock]

Forces folded block string style (using the [code]>[/code] indicator). This treats newlines as spaces, preserving paragraph breaks. Useful for long text that should word-wrap. [codeblock lang=text] folded_string: > Folded block strings treat newlines as spaces. [/codeblock] Is equivalent of: [codeblock lang=text]Folded block strings treat newlines as spaces.[/codeblock]
Lets the YAML stringifier automatically choose the integer format based on content. This is the default behavior and typically uses decimal.
Forces decimal integer format (base 10). This is the standard representation (e.g., [code]42[/code]).
Forces hexadecimal integer format (base 16). Values are prefixed with 0x (e.g., [code]0x2A[/code]).
Forces octal integer format (base 8). Values are prefixed with 0o (e.g., [code]0o52[/code]).
Forces binary integer format (base 2). Values are prefixed with 0b (e.g., [code]0b101010[/code]).
Lets the YAML stringifier automatically choose the float format based on content. This is the default behavior and typically uses decimal.
Forces decimal floating-point format. Values include a decimal point (e.g., [code]3.14159[/code]).
Forces scientific notation for floating-point format. Values use exponent notation (e.g., [code]3.14159e+00[/code]).
